findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_read, web_meta, robots_check, email_check, github_repo, hn_search, json_schema_validate · Private data: pump_pulse, pump_launches, pump_token, pump_wallet, pump_dev, smart_money, copy_backtest, token_risk, launch_scan, counterparty_check, price, wallet_holdings, tx_explain, dlmm_positions, dlmm_whales, chain_tvl, yield_pools, evm_token_security, evm_address, erc20_info, evm_tx, ens_resolve, address_check, domain_whois, email_check, vuln_check, time_convert, qr_code, jwt_decode, random_gen, text_stats · Public sink: pump_history, pump_token, dex_volumes, ens_resolve, address_check, dns_lookup, email_check, json_schema_validate, text_stats · Destructive: evm_token_security, address_check, cron_explain, text_diff.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web_read, web_meta, robots_check, email_check, github_repo, hn_search, json_schema_validate · Private data: pump_pulse, pump_launches, pump_token, pump_wallet, pump_dev, smart_money, copy_backtest, token_risk, launch_scan, counterparty_check, price, wallet_holdings, tx_explain, dlmm_positions, dlmm_whales, chain_tvl, yield_pools, evm_token_security, evm_address, erc20_info, evm_tx, ens_resolve, address_check, domain_whois, email_check, vuln_check, time_convert, qr_code, jwt_decode, random_gen, text_stats · Public sink: pump_history, pump_token, dex_volumes, ens_resolve, address_check, dns_lookup, email_check, json_schema_validate, text_stats · Destructive: evm_token_security, address_check, cron_explain, text_diff

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
